integrity: Self-contained analytic probability proof; finite code checks supplement but do not replace proof. Existing exact Fourier product and Gaussian weak-reset limits acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Independent Poisson rescaling of one-dimensional free Brownian motion, stationary law and |a| approaching one; large deviations of scaled position only, not finite-parameter density asymptotics or dynamical currents. No independent priority verification.
title: Dilogarithmic large deviations of stationary Brownian positions under weak partial resetting
